@deskRailWaitingTor.description: Status word on the sidebar's Epicbox row while the app waits for Tor to connect first. Narrow: one short phrase.

@deskRailOn.description: Status word on a sidebar service row (Epicbox, HTTP): the service is running. One short word.

@deskRailConnecting.description: Status word on the sidebar's Epicbox row: connecting to the Epicbox server. One short word.

@deskRailSlow.description: Status word on the sidebar's Epicbox row: the server answers slowly. One short word.

@deskRailNotAnswering.description: Status word on the sidebar's Epicbox row: the server does not answer. Short phrase.

@deskRailOff.description: Status word on a sidebar service row (Epicbox, HTTP): the service is turned off. One short word.

@deskRailChecking.description: Status word on a sidebar row (Node, Epicbox) while its state is not known yet. One short word.

@deskRailOverTor.description: Line in the sidebar Epicbox hover card: the connection goes through Tor.

@deskRailWaitsForTor.description: Line in the sidebar Epicbox hover card: Epicbox will connect once Tor is up.

deskRailPaymentsWait: Payments wait on the Epicbox server.

@deskRailPaymentsWait.description: Line in the sidebar Epicbox hover card when the Epicbox server does not answer: incoming payments are held until it is back.

@deskRailOpenEpicbox.description: Last line of the sidebar Epicbox hover card: a click opens the Epicbox receiving settings.

@deskRailStarting.description: Status word on a sidebar row (HTTP): the service is starting. One short word.

@deskRailNotReceiving.description: Status word on the sidebar's HTTP row: the HTTP listener failed and nothing can be received that way. Short phrase.

@deskRailOnInternet.description: Second line of the sidebar's HTTP row: running and reachable from the internet. Narrow: keep the · separator.

@deskRailOnLocal.description: Second line of the sidebar's HTTP row: running and reachable on this computer's network only. Narrow: keep the · separator.

@deskRailPortInUse.description: Second line of the sidebar's HTTP row: the chosen port is taken by another program. Narrow.

@deskRailStopped.description: Second line of the sidebar's HTTP row: the HTTP listener stopped. Narrow.

@deskRailPortInternet.description: Line in the sidebar HTTP hover card: the listening port, reachable from the internet.

@deskRailPortLocal.description: Line in the sidebar HTTP hover card: the listening port, reachable from this computer only.

@deskRailOpenHttp.description: Last line of the sidebar HTTP hover card: a click opens the HTTP receiving settings.

@deskRailTorNotInBuild.description: Status word on the sidebar's Tor row when this build of the app does not include Tor.

@deskRailStartingDots.description: Second line of the sidebar's Tor row while Tor starts. Narrow.

@deskRailTorSlow.description: Line in the sidebar Tor hover card when Tor runs but the app's own Tor address is not published; sending still works. {problem} is a short reason, e.g. 'Tor address not published'.

@deskRailTorNoAddress.description: Short reason shown in the sidebar Tor hover card when Tor runs but the receiving address is not published yet.

@deskRailOpenPrivacy.description: Last line of the sidebar Tor hover card: a click opens the Privacy settings.

@deskRailNode.description: Name of the sidebar's first row: the node the wallet reads the chain from. Very short.

@deskRailOpenNode.description: Last line of the sidebar Node hover card: a click opens the node settings.

@deskAppNodeSyncedTitle.description: Title of the dialog shown when the built-in node has finished syncing.

deskAppNodeSyncedBody: The local node has the whole chain and can be used now. The app restarts to switch to it.

@deskAppNodeSyncedBody.description: Body of the dialog shown when the built-in node has finished syncing.

@deskAppNotNow.description: Button of the local-node-synced dialog: postpone the restart. Short.

@deskAppRestartNow.description: Button of the local-node-synced dialog: restart the app and switch to the local node. Short.

@deskAppFirstScanTitle.description: Title of the dialog that shows the first scan of a new wallet.

deskAppFirstScanBody: The wallet looks through the chain for its outputs. It stays usable; the balance updates when the scan is done.

@deskAppScanOutput.description: Screen-reader label of the box listing the scan's progress lines.

@deskAppWaitingOutput.description: Placeholder in the first-scan dialog before the scan has printed anything.

@deskShellNavOverview.description: Sidebar entry and window title: the Overview page (balance and latest transactions). One word where possible.

@deskShellNavActivity.description: Sidebar entry and window title: the list of all transactions. One word where possible.

@deskShellNavSend.description: Sidebar entry and window title: the Send page. One word.

@deskShellNavReceive.description: Sidebar entry and window title: the Receive page. One word.

@deskShellNavOutputs.description: Sidebar entry and window title: the page listing the wallet's outputs (coins). One word where possible.

@deskShellNavContacts.description: Sidebar entry and window title: the address book. One word where possible.

@deskShellNavSettings.description: Sidebar entry, phone top-bar button label and window title: the Settings pages. One word where possible.

@deskShellTitleImportTx.description: Window title of the page where a transaction file is imported.

@deskShellTitleFinalizeTx.description: Window title of the page where a received transaction file is finalized.

deskShellLocksAfterSend: Locks when the payment is sent

@deskShellLocksAfterSend.description: Toast when the user locks the wallet while a payment is still being sent: the lock happens afterwards.

@deskShellNotQuitTitle.description: Toast title when Quit is pressed while a send is in progress.

deskShellNotQuitBody: A send is in progress. Quit again once it finishes.

@deskShellNotQuitBody.description: Toast body when Quit is pressed while a send is in progress.

@deskShellLockedTitle.description: Toast title after Quit in a build that cannot close the app (demo): the wallet was only locked.

deskShellLockedBody: Quit closes the app once the wallet core is connected.

@deskShellLockedBody.description: Toast body after Quit in a build that cannot close the app (demo).

@deskShellLockWallet.description: Tooltip and screen-reader label of the lock button in the sidebar. {keys} is the shortcut, e.g. Ctrl+L or ⌘L.

@deskShellMainNav.description: Screen-reader label of the sidebar that holds the main places.

@deskShellVersion.description: Tooltip of the logo and screen-reader label of the version under the compact sidebar. {version} is the app version.

@deskShellOpenWalletSettings.description: Tooltip of the account row at the bottom of the sidebar: a click opens the wallet's settings.

@deskShellOpenWalletSettingsNamed.description: Screen-reader label of the account row at the bottom of the sidebar. {name} is the wallet's name.

@deskShellSwitchWallet.description: Tooltip of the button next to the account row that locks the wallet so another wallet can be picked.

@deskShellWalletBy.description: Small credit line at the bottom of the sidebar. {maker} is the company's name (BT Labs); the app draws it dimmer.

@deskTourOverviewTitle.description: Title of the tour card for this page (first-unlock tour). Short.

deskTourOverviewText: The balance and what is still confirming, then the latest transactions. Everything else is in the sidebar.

@deskTourOverviewText.description: Text of the tour card for this page (first-unlock tour); one or two short sentences.

@deskTourSendTitle.description: Title of the tour card for this page (first-unlock tour). Short.

deskTourSendText: Pay an Epicbox address, or make a transaction file for someone to sign. A review comes before anything leaves.

@deskTourSendText.description: Text of the Send step of the first-run tour. Names only what is visible by default.

@deskTourReceiveTitle.description: Title of the tour card for this page (first-unlock tour). Short.

deskTourReceiveText: This wallet’s Epicbox address: share it to be paid. Transaction files to sign or finalize are below it.

@deskTourReceiveText.description: Text of the Receive step of the first-run tour.

@deskTourInvoicesTitle.description: Title of the tour card for this page (first-unlock tour). Short.

deskTourInvoicesText: Pay an invoice someone sent, or issue one to someone who owes you. The tabs switch between the two.

@deskTourInvoicesText.description: Text of the tour card for this page (first-unlock tour); one or two short sentences.

@deskTourActivityTitle.description: Title of the tour card for this page (first-unlock tour). Short.

deskTourActivityText: Every transaction with its progress and details. A number on this sidebar entry means something waits for an action.

@deskTourActivityText.description: Text of the tour card for this page (first-unlock tour); one or two short sentences.

@deskTourContactsTitle.description: Title of the tour card for this page (first-unlock tour). Short.

deskTourContactsText: Saved addresses by name. Send picks from here.

@deskTourContactsText.description: Text of the Contacts step of the first-run tour.

@deskTourNodeTitle.description: Title of the tour card for this page (first-unlock tour). Short.

deskTourNodeText: Which node the wallet reads the chain from. The other settings pages are listed on the left.

@deskTourNodeText.description: Text of the Settings › Node step of the first-run tour.

@deskTourHelpTitle.description: Title of the tour card for this page (first-unlock tour). Short.

deskTourHelpText: Help topics, Report a problem and Show the tour again.

@deskTourHelpText.description: Text of the Help step, the last step of the first-run tour.

@deskTourCounter.description: Step counter on the tour card, e.g. '2 of 7'. Narrow: keep it short.

@deskTourSemantics.description: Screen-reader name of the tour card dialog.

@deskTourSkip.description: Button on the tour card: close the tour. Short.

@deskTourBack.description: Button on the tour card: previous step. One word.

@deskTourNext.description: Button on the tour card: next step. One word.

@deskTourAdvancedTitle.description: Title of the Settings › Advanced step of the first-run tour.

deskTourAdvancedText: Tor-only mode, outputs and technical details live here. Switch on what you need.

@deskTourAdvancedText.description: Text of the Settings › Advanced step of the first-run tour. The tour switches nothing on.

@deskAppFirstScanProgress.description: First-scan dialog: the progress line. {percent} is 0–100.

deskAppFirstScanFound: {count, plural, one{{count} output found} other{{count} outputs found}}

@deskAppFirstScanFound.description: First-scan dialog: how many of the wallet's outputs the scan has found so far.

@deskAppFirstScanShowLog.description: First-scan dialog: button that shows the scan's raw output lines.

@deskAppFirstScanHideLog.description: First-scan dialog: button that hides the raw output lines again.
